metadata.scope: Mechanical properties + immutable presets + custom draft data. Not member capacity, connection capacity or construction approval.
metadata.provenance_policy: Source per record, fixed property basis per key, effective overrides separately recorded; latest published content is never auto-adopted in an approved revision.

sources.title: Yamato Steel company brochure — JIS grade mechanical properties
sources.locator: PDF p4 (printed pp5–6), grade table and footnote 7; PDF p5 (printed p8) SS400/SM490A
sources.scope: SS400/SS490/SM490A yield and tensile limits. SS490 library scope conservatively limited to 6–40 mm as visible table. Material governing thickness: H uses flange; I/channel uses web per footnote 7.

sources.title: Pacific Pipe Structural Steel catalogue 2026_2 — TIS107
sources.locator: PDF p10, printed p18 (mechanical properties); PDF p9 product markings
sources.scope: STK400/490 and STKR400/490 minimum yield and minimum tensile strength. Strength ranges are not ultimate test results.

sources.title: Pacific Pipe Structural Steel catalogue 2026_2 — TIS1228
sources.locator: PDF p26, printed p50 grade table, and p51 sections; PDF p9 product markings
sources.scope: SSCS400/490/540 cold formed uncoated grade properties. Nominal thickness in the published grade table up to 6 mm. Not applicable automatically to coated/high-tensile coil.

sources.title: Design of timber structures — Volume 2
sources.scope: C14–C40 strength classes: characteristic strengths, mean/5th percentile elastic values and density. Not equivalence to ungraded Thai timber species.

sources.title: Declaration of Performance UPM007CPR — Structural birch plywood
sources.locator: PDF p1 product scope, p2 density, p3 directional properties; all 14 thicknesses
sources.scope: Characteristic strengths and mean moduli for crosswise veneer structural birch panels. Match actual product DoP, nominal thickness, ply count, coating/edge sealing and exposure. In-plane compression perpendicular to face grain is NOT through-thickness bearing.

sources.title: WISA DoP Reference List
sources.locator: UPM007CPR product family; corroborated by product documentation
sources.scope: Product/DoP selection. Multiple DoPs can apply depending on product, layup and thickness. Actual label governs.

sources.title: หนังสือ Design Form Work — ตาราง 3.4
sources.publisher: User-provided scanned textbook; bibliographic edition not verified
sources.edition: Historical reference; not certified current EIT requirements
sources.locator: Printed p57, Table3.4; original PDF p32/right. Original mounted PDF 314 pages; Files preview indexes only first150.
sources.scope: Five historical Thai timber class reference E and allowable stresses. Original kg/cm2 interpreted as kgf/cm2; conversion 0.0980665 MPa per kgf/cm2. Do not merge with different BMA Table3.5. Original first-class Fv dash retained null.

sources.title: Simplified LRFD Design of Steel Members for Fire — normal temperature example
sources.edition: 2008 Q4 research paper (not a current product standard)
sources.locator: PDF p9, printed p241, normal-temperature E=200000 MPa input
sources.scope: Supports conventional 200 GPa elastic model only. No fire-reduction or code-compliance claims are imported. Project must select its governing material/design model.

sources.title: Steel material properties — Other mechanical properties of steel
sources.publisher: Steel Construction Institute / BCSA information resource
sources.scope: E=210000 MPa, nu=0.3, G=E/[2(1+nu)], alpha=12e-6/C. Alternative elastic model, not a grade-strength definition.

sources.title: Explicit library model assumptions and exact unit conversions
sources.scope: Steel density7850 kg/m3 is an engineering reference assumption, not batch measurement. Standard gravity9.80665 m/s2; no fabrication tolerances or material safety factors implied.

property_definitions.label_th: ความหนาแน่นเฉลี่ย/อ้างอิง
property_definitions.meaning: For self-weight; not characteristic density used in connection design. Steel is explicit model assumption.

property_definitions.label_th: ความหนาแน่นลักษณะเฉพาะ
property_definitions.meaning: For code checks requiring characteristic density; not substituted for self-weight density.

property_definitions.label_th: Young’s modulus — เหล็ก
property_definitions.meaning: Elastic stiffness; not strength. Choose project elastic model.

property_definitions.label_th: Poisson’s ratio — เหล็ก
property_definitions.meaning: Isotropic elastic model only.

property_definitions.label_th: Shear modulus — เหล็ก
property_definitions.meaning: Default E/[2(1+nu)], unless independently overridden and documented.

property_definitions.label_th: สัมประสิทธิ์ขยายตัวความร้อน — เหล็ก
property_definitions.meaning: Ambient-temperature reference; not a fire model.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังครากขั้นต่ำ Fy
property_definitions.meaning: Resolved from grade and applicable material thickness; never a final allowable member stress.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังดึงสูงสุดขั้นต่ำตามเกรด Fu,min
property_definitions.meaning: Minimum specified ultimate tensile strength, not a measured test value.

property_definitions.label_th: ขีดบนกำลังดึงตามเกรด Fu,max
property_definitions.meaning: Upper specification limit when published. Null means not supplied, NOT zero.

property_definitions.label_th: E เฉลี่ยขนานเสี้ยน
property_definitions.meaning: For deflection subject to design method and exposure.

property_definitions.label_th: E ขนานเสี้ยน ค่าร้อยละ5
property_definitions.meaning: For stability where specified by code; not mean E.

property_definitions.label_th: E เฉลี่ยตั้งฉากเสี้ยน
property_definitions.meaning: Transverse timber modulus; do not derive from steel Poisson ratio.

property_definitions.label_th: G เฉลี่ยของไม้
property_definitions.meaning: Source-defined timber shear modulus.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังดัด fm,k
property_definitions.meaning: Characteristic bending strength, not allowable stress or Fy.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังดึงขนานเสี้ยน ft,0,k
property_definitions.meaning: Characteristic tension parallel to grain.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังดึงตั้งฉากเสี้ยน ft,90,k
property_definitions.meaning: Characteristic tension perpendicular to grain.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังอัดขนานเสี้ยน fc,0,k
property_definitions.meaning: Characteristic compression parallel to grain.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังอัดตั้งฉากเสี้ยน fc,90,k
property_definitions.meaning: Timber perpendicular-to-grain compression; not plywood in-plane90 property.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังเฉือน fv,k
property_definitions.meaning: Characteristic shear; code crack/load-duration effects are not yet applied.

property_definitions.label_th: E อ้างอิงจากหนังสือเดิม
property_definitions.meaning: Table3.4 modulus; statistical basis not stated, do not silently rename as mean or E05.

property_definitions.label_th: หน่วยแรงดัดยอมให้พื้นฐาน Fb
property_definitions.meaning: Historical textbook allowable value. Not a current approval, and not a characteristic strength. Adjustment rules require engineer approval.

property_definitions.label_th: หน่วยแรงอัดขนานเสี้ยนยอมให้ Fc0
property_definitions.meaning: Historical textbook allowable value. Not a current approval, and not a characteristic strength. Adjustment rules require engineer approval.

property_definitions.label_th: หน่วยแรงอัดตั้งฉากเสี้ยนยอมให้ Fc90
property_definitions.meaning: Historical textbook allowable value. Not a current approval, and not a characteristic strength. Adjustment rules require engineer approval.

property_definitions.label_th: หน่วยแรงเฉือนยอมให้พื้นฐาน Fv
property_definitions.meaning: Historical textbook allowable value. Not a current approval, and not a characteristic strength. Adjustment rules require engineer approval.

property_definitions.label_th: E ดัดไม้อัด 0°
property_definitions.meaning: Bending parallel to face grain, gross nominal panel convention per DoP.

property_definitions.label_th: E ดัดไม้อัด 90°
property_definitions.meaning: Bending perpendicular to face grain; rotate orientation, not material identity.

property_definitions.label_th: E ดึง/อัดในระนาบไม้อัด 0°
property_definitions.meaning: Axial in-plane modulus parallel to face grain, not bending E.

property_definitions.label_th: E ดึง/อัดในระนาบไม้อัด 90°
property_definitions.meaning: Axial in-plane modulus perpendicular to face grain, not through thickness.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังดัดไม้อัด 0°
property_definitions.meaning: Characteristic bending parallel to face grain.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังดัดไม้อัด 90°
property_definitions.meaning: Characteristic bending perpendicular to face grain.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังดึงในระนาบไม้อัด 0°
property_definitions.meaning: In-plane tensile characteristic strength; not test ultimate.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังดึงในระนาบไม้อัด 90°
property_definitions.meaning: In-plane tensile characteristic strength; not test ultimate.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังอัดในระนาบไม้อัด 0°
property_definitions.meaning: In-plane compression parallel to face grain.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังอัดในระนาบไม้อัด 90°
property_definitions.meaning: In-plane compression perpendicular to face grain; NOT through-thickness bearing.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังเฉือนในระนาบแผ่น
property_definitions.meaning: Panel shear; different from planar/rolling shear in bending.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลัง planar shear 0°
property_definitions.meaning: Planar/rolling shear parallel to face grain per DoP.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลัง planar shear 90°
property_definitions.meaning: Planar/rolling shear perpendicular to face grain per DoP.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังอัดทะลุความหนา/กดรองรับไม้อัด
property_definitions.meaning: Not declared in selected DoP. Remains null; obtain bearing data separately.

property_definitions.label_th: G เฉือนในระนาบไม้อัด
property_definitions.meaning: DoP labels Mean MOR in panel shear; G symbol interpreted as modulus of rigidity, not modulus of rupture.

property_definitions.label_th: G planar shear ไม้อัด 0°
property_definitions.meaning: Planar/rolling shear rigidity parallel to face grain.

property_definitions.label_th: G planar shear ไม้อัด 90°
property_definitions.meaning: Planar/rolling shear rigidity perpendicular to face grain.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังดัดสูงสุดจากการทดสอบ MOR
property_definitions.meaning: No default. Actual test result + specimen/method/moisture/statistics required; not usable as characteristic or allowable strength automatically.

property_definitions.label_th: กำลังดึงสูงสุดจากการทดสอบ
property_definitions.meaning: No default. Actual test result required; cannot substitute for Fy or a design tensile value.
